# Narrative Role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NarrativeRole`](gmeow-NarrativeRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NarrativeRole>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A character's narratological function — an OPEN value vocabulary (protagonist, antagonist, mentor, foil, narrator, confidant, love interest, trickster, …), Propp/Greimas-informed but never closed: traditions disagree about the role inventory itself ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). A role is a FUNCTION RELATIVE TO A SCOPE, not an intrinsic property — carried by the [`RoleInNarrative`](gmeow-RoleInNarrative.md) relator, never by typing the character.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NarrativeRole`](gmeow-NarrativeRole.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
